— INDEX · PRICING

# Same advantage. _Different depth of vetting._

Both tracks run on proprietary AI, our private talent database, our curated technical network, and our recruiting judgment. Pricing is pure success-fee — you pay only when a candidate we introduced is hired. The difference between Agentic and Atelier is how much human technical vetting happens before candidates reach your team.

01 · FOR SPEED

## Agentic

Fast, automated recruiting

7%success fee · first-year base

**AI-powered technical recruiting for speed.** For teams that need qualified candidates quickly. Agentic uses our proprietary AI to search, screen, interview, score, and rank candidates automatically. Built for urgent IC roles, backfills, and searches where speed matters.

◇AI-powered sourcing across the open web

◇Candidate matching from our proprietary database

◇Structured AI interviews with transcript & scoring

◇Automated candidate ranking

◇First qualified shortlist in 24–48 hours

◇60-day replacement window

BEST FORMid to senior IC roles, backfills, scale-up hiring waves.

FOR ROLES WHERE YOU NEED THE TOP 3%

The top 3%

Both tiers sit below the 15% to 25% a UK contingency agency typically charges, and the 25% to 33% charged on retained search — see [recruitment agency fees UK](https://on3works.com/resources/recruitment-agency-fees-uk), or put your own salary into the [recruitment fee calculator](https://on3works.com/tools/recruitment-fee-calculator). For the full picture on [how AI-native fees compare to traditional agencies](https://on3works.com/compare/ai-recruiting-vs-traditional-agency)— including what each fee actually buys in vetting depth — see the model comparison.

— PRICING QUESTIONS

## The fine _print._

Is there any upfront cost or retainer?

No. Both Agentic and Atelier are pure success-fee. You only pay when a candidate we introduced is hired and starts.

How is the fee calculated?

The success fee is a percentage of the candidate's first-year base salary, invoiced on their start date.

What happens if the hire does not work out?

Agentic includes a 60-day replacement window. Atelier includes 90 days. Within that period we replace the role at no additional fee.

Can we mix the two tracks?

Yes. Many teams run Atelier on critical leadership roles and Agentic on parallel IC backfills. We will recommend a track per role on the kickoff call.

— TALK TO US

## Not sure which track? _Tell us about the role._

Share a brief — seniority, location, the systems they will own — and we will recommend Agentic or Atelier and come back with qualified candidates, typically within 24–48 hours.
